response.title: which floor rising projector screen stays flat without wrinkles
response.answer:
If you want a floor-rising projector screen that stays flat without wrinkles, look for a tab-tensioned ALR screen, rather than a standard motorized floor-rising screen.

The key is the tensioning system, not just the screen material.

Tab-tensioned edges: Help prevent waves, curling, and wrinkles.

Rigid or well-supported crossbar: Keeps the top edge straight.

High-quality screen material: Reduces the risk of permanent creases.

Proper storage and temperature: Help prevent deformation over time.

Even expensive tensioned screens can develop slight waves, so no flexible floor-rising screen is guaranteed to remain perfectly flat forever.
